title: Stationary Strings Theorem VII: Self-Consistent Vortex Saturation in CERN ALPHA Antimatter Traps, First-Principles Hyperfine Lineshape Derivation, and the Exact 511 keV Ore-Powell Spectrum Resolution
description: Seventh link of the series (October 2026): SDR-EVC rotating-wall torque discrepancy resolved (Test T16), first-principles hyperfine lineshape and flux-drift analysis (Test T17), exact Ore-Powell logarithmic correction with Galactic 511 keV rate (Test T18). Full paper in Turkish and English. Tests T16-T18 run with the solver in the Paper V repository (stationary-strings-v).
